1445. Quickselect: K-th Smallest with Duplicates

40

Medium

Problem Statement:
Create a program to find the k-th smallest element in an array. The twist is that you must implement the Quickselect algorithm and handle arrays with duplicate values efficiently.
input_spec: The first line contains an integer n, the number of elements in the array. The second line contains n integers, the elements of the array. The third line contains an integer k, the position (1-based) of the smallest element to find.
output_spec: A single integer, the k-th smallest element in the array.
